unresolvedRisks: An audit-emission gate is not an acceptance authority: it must never mutate result.receipt and needs an explicit host-side off switch.
The gitignored shared log is invisible in CI checkouts; enforcement is runtime-only and tests must isolate CSM_TRACE_LOG.
Mirrored loop CLIs cannot import scripts/; loop-level enforcement is out of scope (the host gate covers the primary threat).

assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Default policy is auto (gate only when the run scheduled tracing), not required.
The gate is audit-emission only; it never mutates result.receipt; off is reachable only from a host-side flag/env, never repo config.
Jev is consulted only after the deterministic check, only with an opted-in adapter, and never affects the exit code; its consumer is a decision trace.
Loop-CLI-level enforcement is out of scope (closure gate + spoofable attestation); the host gate covers the primary threat.
Run-id scoping is the only basis; no --since.
